sections.title: The Coming Day of the Lord
observations: Malachi concludes his prophecy with a powerful declaration about the coming day of the Lord, which will bring judgment and purification.
This day is described as a burning furnace, emphasizing the intensity of God's judgment against the wicked.
The righteous, in contrast, will experience healing and joy, symbolized by the sun of righteousness rising with healing in its wings.

sections.title: The Call to Remember the Law
observations: In this section, God calls His people to remember the law of Moses, which He gave at Horeb.
This reminder serves as a call to obedience and faithfulness to God's covenant, highlighting the importance of the law in the life of Israel.
The promise of a prophet before the great and dreadful day of the Lord indicates God's continued guidance and revelation to His people.

importantVerses.commentary: The day of the Lord is coming, burning like a furnace, indicating imminent judgment.
The sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings, symbolizing hope and restoration for the faithful.

questions: What does the imagery of the day of the Lord reveal about God's character and His justice?
How can we apply the call to remember the law of Moses in our contemporary context?
In what ways does the promise of a coming prophet relate to the New Testament revelation of Jesus Christ?
